'''Amplified Research''' projects are specialized research tasks at the [[Research Station]] that unlock powerful [[Amplification|Weapon Amplifications]].

== Overview ==
Completing an Amplified Research project follows a two-step progression:
* '''Step 1:''' Complete specific combat challenges, damage milestones, or exploration tasks.
* '''Step 2:''' Submit '''5,000 [[Research Points]]''' along with ARC components.

Once completed, the unlocked Amplification becomes permanently available for activation on eligible Level 5 [[Amplified Weapons]].

== Requirements ==
To access and complete Amplified Research projects, raiders must upgrade their [[Workshop|workshops]]:
* [[Research Station|'''Research Station''']] Level 4
